close_reason: Already fixed in lifecycle.rs: Command::Stat(Some(ArticleRef::MessageId)) is intercepted before dispatch and handled by stat_by_msgid() which queries msgid_map and returns 223 for known articles. Tests stat_by_msgid_known_returns_223 and stat_by_msgid_unknown_returns_430 confirm.
description:
## Why This Exists

RFC 3977 §6.2.4 requires STAT <message-id> to return 223 when the article is known, not 430. The commands/group.rs::stat_article() function returns 430 when passed a message-ID form. fault_store_errors.rs documents this as 'the v1 stub; message-ID lookups are not yet wired to IPFS storage'. While the test accepts 430, RFC 3977 requires 223 on success and 430 only when the article does not exist. A live query against the msgid_map is needed.

## Acceptance Criteria

stat_article with a known message-ID must return 223. The lookup must go through msgid_map, not just return 430.
title: stat_article returns 430 for msgid form, not 223 success
